aboutGame.title: A world worth getting lost in.
aboutGame.description: Example Game is an imaginary adventure RPG set in the Greenhollow Vale. Ancient paths, patient combat and small discoveries give this demo its shape. It is a fictional setting built to show what a focused game wiki can be.
aboutGame.imageAlt: Fictional Greenhollow Vale with forested mountains and ancient stone ruins

faq.question: Is Example Game a real game?
faq.answer: No. Example Game is a fictional setting created to demonstrate this wiki template. All codes, items, encounters and statistics are invented.

faq.question: Where should I start?
faq.answer: The First Steps guide connects the demo’s combat basics, equipment and first encounter. It is also a useful example of a concise, answer-first article.

faq.question: Can I read this wiki in another language?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the language menu to open an existing translation of the current page. Untranslated pages are not published as duplicate language versions.

aboutGame.title: 一个值得探索的世界。
aboutGame.description: Example Game 是虚构的冒险角色扮演游戏，故事发生在绿荫谷。古老的道路、讲究节奏的战斗与路途上的小发现，共同组成了这个演示世界。

faq.question: Example Game 是真实游戏吗？
faq.answer: 不是。这是为展示模板而创作的虚构世界，所有兑换码、物品、首领与属性均为演示数据。

faq.question: 为什么中文页面的攻略较少？
faq.answer: 演示中仅入门攻略提供了中文译文。语言切换仅指向真实存在的译文，不会生成虚假的翻译页面。
